title: China-to-Georgia Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Georgia uses a 220/380 V, 50 Hz supply, which is a genuine nominal match with China's 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline. Corded tools, chargers, and external power supplies should still be supported by Georgia-accepted safety evidence through the national conformity route, normally using Georgian GOST IEC adoptions of IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 for power tools and relevant charger standards.
target_standards: GeoSTM national standards and conformity assessment route
Georgian GOST IEC 60745 or GOST IEC 62841 adopted standards for power tools
Georgia mains supply: 220/380 V, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly use GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 for power-tool safety and separate charger evidence where applicable. The nominal 220/380 V, 50 Hz rating is aligned with Georgia, but the report set still needs mapping to the Georgian national standard adoption and certificate route.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: Voltage and frequency are not the main gap because both markets use 220/380 V, 50 Hz nominally. The gap is documentary: a China GB 3883 file should be cross-mapped to Georgia's GOST IEC 60745/62841 adoption and national certificate expectations instead of being treated as an automatic Georgian approval.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for in-scope electrical products: national conformity evidence through GeoSTM-recognised Georgian standards and certification practice.
target.zh: 对适用电气产品实务上强制：通过 GeoSTM 认可的格鲁吉亚标准和认证实践提供国家合格证据。
target.zht: 對適用電氣產品實務上強制：通過 GeoSTM 認可的格魯吉亞標準和認證實務提供國家合格證據。

cn.en: China baseline commonly uses GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国基线通常使用 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883，并在适用时使用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國基線通常使用 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883，並在適用時使用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally acceptable only after the China GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 file is mapped to Georgia-accepted GOST IEC 60745/62841 evidence and the tool, charger, and markings are confirmed for 220/380 V, 50 Hz.

source.publisher: GeoSTM - Georgian National Agency for Standards and Metrology

rows.target_requirement: Georgia expects EMC evidence for electrical products through national conformity assessment and standards adoption rather than EU CE self-declaration alone. Cordless tools with Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, wireless charging communication, or other radio interfaces may also need GNCC radio approval in addition to GeoSTM-oriented product evidence.
target_standards: GeoSTM national standards and conformity assessment route for EMC evidence
Georgia national EMC conformity practice for electrical products
GNCC approval for radio interfaces where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly include GB 4343-series EMC evidence for motor-operated tools and CCC documentation where the product or accessory is in scope. Radio modules may have separate China radio approvals, but those are not a substitute for GNCC approval in Georgia.
china_standards: GB 4343 series EMC for household appliances, electric tools, and similar apparatus
rows.gap: A GB 4343 report is useful technical evidence but should be mapped to Georgia-accepted EMC standards and certificate practice. Any radio function creates a separate Georgia-specific GNCC check; it should not be hidden inside the general power-tool EMC file.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for electrical EMC evidence under national conformity assessment; GNCC approval is additionally relevant for radio functions.
target.zh: 电气 EMC 证据在国家合格评定下实务上强制；无线电功能还需另行关注 GNCC 批准。
target.zht: 電氣 EMC 證據在國家合格評定下實務上強制；無線電功能還需另行關注 GNCC 批准。

cn.en: China baseline commonly uses GB 4343 EMC evidence and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国基线通常使用 GB 4343 EMC 证据，并在适用时使用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國基線通常使用 GB 4343 EMC 證據，並在適用時使用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally acceptable only after GB 4343 EMC evidence is mapped to Georgia's national conformity route and any Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or other radio function is checked separately with GNCC.

rows.target_requirement: Georgia is not an EAEU member, so EAEU TR CU / EAC certification should not be presented as the Georgia route. Georgia has an EU Association Agreement and DCFTA with gradual EU-technical approximation, but that is not full automatic EU adoption. Power tools should be handled through GeoSTM-oriented national standards and conformity assessment, with Georgian-language labelling and import documentation. Main sea-entry routes include Poti and Batumi on the Black Sea.
target_standards: GeoSTM national standards and metrology framework
Georgia-EU Association Agreement and DCFTA technical approximation context
National-language labelling for consumer products
Import entry through Poti or Batumi where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China export packs often contain GB 3883 safety reports, GB 4343 EMC reports, CCC documents where applicable, Chinese/English labels, and commercial shipping documents. These documents support a Georgia submission but do not replace Georgia-specific national labelling, certificate, importer, or customs checks.
rows.gap: The common risk is choosing the wrong regional route. Georgia is not EAEU, and EU DCFTA approximation does not make CE marking or EU declarations alone an automatic Georgia market-access file. Prepare a Georgia-specific file with GeoSTM standard mapping, Georgian-language labelling, importer details, and port/customs documentation for Poti or Batumi shipments.

target.en: Mandatory in practice: Georgia-specific national conformity, labelling, importer, and customs checks; no EAEU TR CU / EAC route for Georgia.
target.zh: 实务上强制：格鲁吉亚专用的国家合格评定、标签、进口商和海关核查；格鲁吉亚不适用 EAEU TR CU / EAC 路径。
target.zht: 實務上強制：格魯吉亞專用的國家合格評定、標籤、進口商和海關核查；格魯吉亞不適用 EAEU TR CU / EAC 路徑。

cn.en: China baseline evidence supports technical review but must be repackaged for Georgia-specific certification and labelling.
cn.zh: 中国基线证据可支持技术审查，但必须重新整理为格鲁吉亚专用认证和标签文件。
cn.zht: 中國基線證據可支援技術審查，但必須重新整理為格魯吉亞專用認證和標籤文件。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not ready if the file relies on EAEU TR CU, EAC, or EU CE paperwork alone. Prepare a Georgia-specific GeoSTM mapping, Georgian-language labelling, importer record, and customs file for the actual route through Poti, Batumi, or another entry point.

source.publisher: GeoSTM - Georgian National Agency for Standards and Metrology

rows.requirement: Noise, Workplace Safety, and Outdoor Equipment
rows.target_requirement: Georgia should be mapped to national occupational health and safety expectations and product safety documentation for noise information. There is no confirmed Georgia equivalent of the EU Outdoor Noise Directive as a fully in-force power-tool product-marking regime. Noise values for drills, grinders, saws, and outdoor tools should be included in manuals and safety information when required by the adopted tool standard and OHS practice.
target_standards: Georgia national occupational health and safety requirements
GeoSTM adopted power-tool safety standards requiring noise information where applicable
No confirmed fully in-force EU-style Outdoor Noise Directive product-marking regime for Georgia
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files may include noise and vibration data generated under GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 tool safety testing, plus workplace safety information in manuals. This data is useful, but it is not an EU outdoor-noise declaration and should be presented as safety/manual information for Georgia.
china_standards: GB 3883 / GB/T 3883 series noise and vibration information where applicable
China workplace safety and instruction-manual evidence
rows.gap: Do not copy the EU outdoor-noise directive row into Georgia. The practical gap is ensuring noise and vibration values, warnings, PPE references, and Georgian-language instructions are present where the adopted power-tool standard and OHS practice expect them.

target.en: National OHS and product-safety information requirement where applicable; no confirmed standalone EU-style outdoor-noise product-marking regime.
target.zh: 适用时为国家职业安全和产品安全信息要求；没有已确认的独立欧盟式户外噪声产品标识制度。
target.zht: 適用時為國家職業安全和產品安全資訊要求；沒有已確認的獨立歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標識制度。

cn.en: China baseline may include GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 noise and vibration evidence.
cn.zh: 中国基线可能包含 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 噪声与振动证据。
cn.zht: 中國基線可能包含 GB 3883 或 GB/T 3883 噪聲與振動證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not require an EU outdoor-noise declaration unless a Georgia-specific rule is confirmed. Treat China noise and vibration data as supporting safety/manual content and localise the relevant warnings into Georgian.

source.publisher: GeoSTM - Georgian National Agency for Standards and Metrology

rows.target_requirement: Georgia has EU Association Agreement and DCFTA technical-approximation commitments, but there is no fully in-force horizontal EU-style RoHS regime confirmed as a standalone market-access gate for power tools. Substance information should be handled honestly as supporting material safety evidence, customs/product-safety documentation, and future-approximation watch items rather than as a current Georgia RoHS declaration.
target_standards: Georgia-EU Association Agreement and DCFTA technical approximation context
No confirmed fully in-force horizontal RoHS regime for power tools
General product safety, customs, and environmental controls where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China files may include China RoHS substance disclosure and marking evidence, alongside GB 3883 safety and GB 4343 EMC files. That evidence can support buyer, customs, or material-safety review in Georgia but should not be labelled as satisfying a Georgia RoHS regime that is not confirmed in force.
china_standards: China RoHS substance disclosure and marking where applicable
rows.gap: The honest gap is absence of a confirmed current Georgia horizontal RoHS gate, not a missing EU RoHS declaration. Keep China RoHS documents as useful support, but do not copy EU RoHS obligations into the Georgia target column.

target.en: No confirmed standalone mandatory horizontal RoHS declaration for Georgia power tools; monitor EU-approximation changes.
target.zh: 没有已确认适用于格鲁吉亚电动工具的独立强制横向 RoHS 声明；需持续关注欧盟趋同变化。
target.zht: 沒有已確認適用於格魯吉亞電動工具的獨立強制橫向 RoHS 聲明；需持續關注歐盟趨同變化。

cn.en: China RoHS evidence may support material review but is not a Georgia RoHS approval.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 证据可支持材料审查，但不是格鲁吉亚 RoHS 批准。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 證據可支援材料審查，但不是格魯吉亞 RoHS 批准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not mark a Georgia file non-compliant for lacking an EU-style RoHS declaration unless a Georgia-specific horizontal RoHS rule is confirmed. Use China RoHS data as supporting material information.

rows.target_requirement: For cordless power tools, Georgia should be mapped to battery safety evidence under the national product file, commonly using GOST IEC 62133 / IEC 62133-type evidence for rechargeable cells and battery packs, plus UN 38.3 for lithium-battery transport. There is no confirmed Georgia equivalent of the EU Battery Regulation with battery passport and economic-operator duties as a fully in-force standalone regime.
target_standards: GOST IEC 62133 / IEC 62133-type rechargeable cell and battery safety evidence
UN 38.3 lithium battery transport test for shipment
GeoSTM-oriented national product file for cordless power tools
GNCC check if the battery system includes radio or wireless-charging communication
rows.china_equivalent: China cordless-tool files commonly include GB 3883 or GB/T 3883 tool safety, GB 31241 battery safety where applicable, and UN 38.3 transport evidence for lithium batteries. These are useful inputs but should be cross-mapped to GOST IEC 62133 / IEC 62133-type expectations for Georgia.
china_standards: GB 31241 lithium battery safety where applicable
rows.gap: Do not import EU Battery Regulation obligations into Georgia. The practical gap is to verify the battery pack against IEC 62133-type safety evidence accepted in the Georgia file, retain UN 38.3 for transport, and separately check GNCC only if the pack or charger has radio communication.

target.en: Battery safety evidence is expected for cordless-tool product files; UN 38.3 is required for lithium-battery transport. No confirmed standalone EU-style battery passport regime for Georgia.
target.zh: 无绳工具产品文件通常需要电池安全证据；锂电池运输需要 UN 38.3。没有已确认适用于格鲁吉亚的独立欧盟式电池护照制度。
target.zht: 無繩工具產品文件通常需要電池安全證據；鋰電池運輸需要 UN 38.3。沒有已確認適用於格魯吉亞的獨立歐盟式電池護照制度。

cn.en: China baseline may include GB 31241, UN 38.3, and GB 3883 / GB/T 3883 evidence.
cn.zh: 中国基线可能包含 GB 31241、UN 38.3 以及 GB 3883 / GB/T 3883 证据。
cn.zht: 中國基線可能包含 GB 31241、UN 38.3 以及 GB 3883 / GB/T 3883 證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally acceptable after the battery pack is supported by GOST IEC 62133 / IEC 62133-type evidence and UN 38.3 transport documentation. Do not add EU battery-passport duties unless Georgia-specific implementation is confirmed.

source.publisher: GeoSTM - Georgian National Agency for Standards and Metrology
